==Hero Usage==
* Heroes appropriately use "Fall Back!" to boost the party's speed. They will not use "Fall Back!" if all party members are already under the effects of another movement increasing skill, e.g. [[Charge]]. This also applies to consumables that increase movement speed, e.g. [[Essence of Celerity]].
